so_what: OrourkeP has no healthy quarterback: Mayfield (3+ weeks) and Caleb Williams (3-4 weeks) are his only two, so his 100 FAAB goes to a bridge starter or a QB-rich roster gets his attention this week.
Eharmon1986 had the worst week in the league: Achane gone for the year, Jefferson day-to-day, 1-2 with RB, QB and TE all weak spots, and the most motivated trade partner for anyone with RB depth.

Ollie Gordon is the contested add with every rival but tyanserg at 100 FAAB and almost no bid history; in a 12-team pool expect a high clearing price, with kate0826, LaPray0814, BrylerAnderson and BrittAndTheBoys also RB-needy.
kate0826 is 2nd on paper but has Hall, Coker and Pierce all hurt; the likeliest strong team to trade WR depth for a back.
sbbroom's Hurts, Barkley and DeVonta Smith all stalled together on Monday; concentrated Eagles risk, not a reason for a 2-1 team to sell.
Dobbins's goal-line role in Denver's committee is worth a flex here through Week 6, and BrylerAnderson cutting him left a real back on a thin wire.
